hook: Niki Parmar earned a bachelor's degree in information technology from the Pune Institute of Computer Technology in India, then a master's degree in computer science from the University of Southern California. She joined Google in 2015 as an engineer and research scientist, working on end to end deep learning systems for natural language processing. In 2017, reportedly the youngest member of her team and the only one without a PhD, she co-authored Attention Is All You Need, the paper that introduced the Transformer architecture. She spent close to seven years at Google before co-founding Adept AI Labs in 2022 as Chief Technology Officer, building enterprise workflow automation tools, and then co-founding Essential AI in 2023 to build full stack AI products for automating data processing, with backing from Google and Nvidia. She has since also worked as a member of technical staff at Anthropic on reliable and interpretable AI systems.
